title: DICE-3D Single-Video Pilot
description: A counterbalanced single-video judgment task for internal consistency between speech, text and 3D co-speech motion.

svs002.transcript: a call back i forgot about it three months later i was sitting on my couch

display_transcripts.en: I forgot about a call back. Three months later, I was sitting on my couch.
display_transcripts.zh: 我忘了要回一个电话。三个月后，我正坐在家里的沙发上。
display_transcripts.ja: 折り返しの電話を忘れていました。3か月後、私はソファに座っていました。

svs001.transcript: houses but there's people that hate you if you become successful if you have a lot of money what happens

display_transcripts.en: If you become successful and have a lot of money, some people will hate you. What happens then?
display_transcripts.zh: 如果你成功了、赚了很多钱，有些人会因此讨厌你。那会发生什么呢？
display_transcripts.ja: 成功して大金を持つようになると、あなたを嫌う人もいます。そのとき何が起きるでしょうか？

svs005.transcript: into this trash can picks up a trash can and put it right in front of the students there right in front of them

display_transcripts.en: He picks up a trash can and puts it right in front of the students—right in front of them.
display_transcripts.zh: 他拿起一个垃圾桶，放到学生们正前方——就在他们眼前。
display_transcripts.ja: 彼はごみ箱を持ち上げ、生徒たちのすぐ前、本当に目の前に置きます。

svs004.transcript: this is for you and this is ii really i humbly accept your donation and it will be good to my

display_transcripts.en: This is for you. I truly and humbly accept your donation.
display_transcripts.zh: 这是给你的。我真诚而谦逊地接受你的捐赠。
display_transcripts.ja: これはあなたのためです。ご寄付を心から謹んでお受けします。

svs010.transcript: happens if he does this if he goes there if you go here if i go this what if i do this so there's

display_transcripts.en: What happens if he does this, if he goes there, if you come here, or if I do this?
display_transcripts.zh: 如果他这样做、他去那里、你来这里，或者我这样做，会发生什么？
display_transcripts.ja: 彼がこうしたら、そこへ行ったら、あなたがここへ来たら、あるいは私がこうしたら、どうなるでしょうか？

svs009.transcript: because the next thing i knew i was being beaten by one of the men i think i took a hit to my nose

display_transcripts.en: The next thing I knew, I was being beaten by one of the men. I think I took a hit to my nose.
display_transcripts.zh: 紧接着，我发现自己正被其中一名男子殴打。我想我的鼻子挨了一拳。
display_transcripts.ja: 次に気づいたとき、私は男の一人に殴られていました。鼻を殴られたと思います。

display_transcripts.ja: 今は週に3日ほどヨガをしていて、それで気分が良くなります。

display_transcripts.zh: 我必须让孩子们准备好：赶快吃饭、刷牙、洗漱、穿好衣服，然后出门。
